rows.name: PathOwner_Destroy
rows.comment: [MAP-06.1] Thiscall ECX owner. Path owner destructor; first call 6f15b620. Callers 6f0509d0 (owner replacement), 6f053110, 6f04c020.

rows.name: PathOwner_Replace
rows.comment: [MAP-06.1] Thiscall ECX seed; SMemAlloc(0x978) + PathOwner_Construct, destroy+free the previous [6fd53a48], publish the new owner.

rows.name: Mover_RetireSpatialObjects
rows.comment: [MAP-06.1] Thiscall ECX mover, stack4 forwarded; RET4. Mover +4C |= 0x1000000, 6f161180, SpatialObject_Retire on +94 (proximity) then +98 (fine), clear both, 6f160f70.

rows.name: PathMaps_Release
rows.comment: [MAP-06.1] Thiscall ECX owner, RET0. Vtable+10(0) releases +24C/+250 search systems, +234/+238 proximity maps and +23C..248 accelerator maps; clears each owner slot. Live ChangeLevel and eight RestartGame cycles retire all movers/regions before release; no outstanding live spatial objects.

rows.name: PathMaps_Create
rows.comment: [MAP-06.1] Thiscall ECX owner, stack4/8 descriptors. Calls PathMaps_Release 6f15b670 first (6f15ab81), then creates fresh search/proximity/accelerator maps. Reload rebuilds geometry, storage, maintenance and mover state; first movement repeats exactly before teardown.
rows.signature: void __thiscall PathMaps_Create(WC3PathOwnerCounterPrefix * owner, uint cookie, uint * fine_dimensions)
